Current DRK job material confirms the gGmbH remains the operating employer in 2026. Registry-derived evidence identifies the distinct company at Amtsgericht Hamburg HRB 193382. The store is open to ordinary shoppers and sells used clothing at prices, but no current item-level remote apparel catalogue, checkout or ordinary delivery to Spain is established, so the operator is VERIFIED_HOLD rather than ELIGIBLE.
